payout_live_claim_uq.name: payout_live_claim_uq
payout_live_claim_uq.where: "payout"."status" NOT IN ('failed', 'returned') AND "payout"."claim_id" IS NOT NULL

payout_live_award_uq.name: payout_live_award_uq
payout_live_award_uq.where: "payout"."status" NOT IN ('failed', 'returned') AND "payout"."award_id" IS NOT NULL

payout_source_fk.name: payout_source_fk
payout_source_fk.value: ("payout"."source_type" = 'claim' AND "payout"."claim_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payout"."award_id" IS NULL) OR ("payout"."source_type" = 'award' AND "payout"."award_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payout"."claim_id" IS NULL)
